Chapter One: Some Food We Could Not Eat

Chapter Two: The Bones of the Dead

Chapter Three: The Labor of Gratitude

Chapter Five: The Gift Community

Chapter Seven: Usury: A History of Gift Exchange

Part II: Two Experiments in Gift Aesthetics

Chapter Eight: The Commerce of the Creative Spirit

Chapter Nine: A Draft of Whitman

Chapter Ten: Ezra Pound and the Fate of Vegetable Money

By now a modern classic, The Gift is a brilliantly orchestrated defense of the value of creativity and of its importance in a culture increasingly governed by money and overrun with commodities. This book is even more necessary today than when it first appeared.

An illuminating and transformative book, and completely original in its view of the world, The Gift is cherished by artists, writers, musicians, and thinkers. It is in itself a gift to all who discover the classic wisdom found in its pages.

Gifts pass from hand to hand: they endure through such transmission, as every time a gift is given it is enlivened and regenerated through the new spiritual life it engenders both in the giver and in the receiver.

And so it is with Lewis Hyde’s classic study of gift giving and its relationship to art. The Gift has never been out of print; it moves like an underground current among artists of all kinds, through word of mouth and bestowal. It is the one book I recommend without fail to aspiring writers and painters and musicians, for it is not a how-to book—there are many of these—but a book about the core nature of what it is that artists do and also about the relation of these activities to our overwhelmingly commercial society. If you want to write, paint, sing, compose, act, or make films, read The Gift. It will help to keep you sane.

I doubt that Lewis Hyde knew while he was writing it that he was composing such an essential work. Perhaps he felt he was merely exploring a subject of interest to him—in its short form, why poets in our society are seldom rich—and enjoying the many tributaries he was uncovering through his exploration without realizing that he had hit on a wellspring. When asked by his original editor who his presumed audience was, he couldn’t really pinpoint it but settled for “poets.” “That’s not what most editors want to hear,” as he says in his preface to the 2007 edition. “Many prefer ‘dog owners seeking news of the dead.’ ” As he then tells us, “the happy fact is that The Gift has managed to find an audience beyond the community of poets.” This is an understatement of some vastness.

I first encountered both Lewis Hyde and The Gift in the summer of 1984. I was in the midst of writing The Handmaid’s Tale, begun in the spring in that combination of besieged city and consumer showcase that was West Berlin at the time and where the twentieth-century clash between communitarianism gone wrong and Mammon worship gone wild was most starkly in evidence. But now it was July, and I was in Port Townsend, Washington, at a summer school for writers of the kind that were then multiplying. In that secluded …

author: Isaac Nellist
title: University of Sydney threatens to throttle student body for being pro-Palestine
content:
University of Sydney (USyd) management is pursuing its anti-democratic practices, with a threat to defund the main student representative body and take over its election process.

It comes as NSW Labor Premier Chris Minns and Prime Minister Anthony Albanese intervened in the recent Student Representative Council (SRC) elections, describing a pro-Palestine “Globalise the Intifada” ticket as antisemitic.

It appears that they lent on Usyd management, which is now threatening to defund and take over the SRC elections.

Honi Soit reported on September 28 that a source, “privy to proceedings of the University Senate”, said that Vice-Chancellor Mark Scott “raised the possibility of the university taking over responsibility for SRC elections”. It was an un-minuted segment of the meeting.

The recent SRC elections returned incumbent president Grace Street, who led the Grassroots ticket, which is also pro-Palestine. A referendum on the university cutting ties with Israel and weapons companies complicit in genocide was held at the same time and passed with about 90% of the vote.

Scott and Chancellor David Thodey released a statement claiming that the phrase “Globalise the intifada” is “hate speech” and “incit[es] violence”.

“We reject the contention that this phrase is innocuous,” Scott and Thodey said. “The deliberately provocative use of this slogan has caused — and continues to cause — overwhelming distress to members of our University community. These hateful campaigns must stop.” They also threatened to report students to “police, federal intelligence and counter terrorism agencies”.

USyd management has threatened and shut down anti-genocide activism on campus, including in May sending disciplinary letters to students for displaying the Handala symbol, a symbol of Palestinians’ struggle for freedom and self-determination.

It appointed pro-Israel academic Michael Abrahams-Sprod as its special advisor on antisemitism. Abrahams-Sprod is a leading member of the pro-Israel Australian Academic Alliance Against Antisemitism (5A), which considers any pro-Palestine activism to be antisemitic.

The university has form. In 2024, it introduced its Campus Access Policy, curtailing freedom of speech and the right to protest on campus, following the successful Palestine solidarity encampment.

Management’s new threats have prompted the USyd SRC to publish an open letter; it quickly drew hundreds of signatories from students, staff, alumni, community members and several Palestine solidarity and student organisations.

It said management’s proposal contradicts a 2019 Model Code for the Protection of Freedom of Speech and Academic Freedom that USyd had adopted, which states that free speech — even when controversial, offensive, or challenging — “should not be subject to university penalties”.

It said management’s concerns are being “manufactured and weaponised to justify the vilification, defunding, and removal of the independence of the SRC once and for all”, and is another example of the university trying to “silence progressive voices”.

Further, the letter said ticket names that are “racist, sexist, ableist, homophobic, transphobic or classist” are already prohibited. “Globalise the Intifada” is not a discriminatory phrase. “There is no room for doubt in understanding this phrase and campaign as one [which is] calling for justice and an end to violence.”

Timothy Roberts, president of the NSW Council for Civil Liberties, told Honi Soit that USyd’s proposal would create a “massive conflict of interest” if management writes the rules for the student representatives, “whose job it is to voice student concerns and to hold management accountable”.

The open letter calls for Usyd management to respect the independence of the SRC and that any review of its funding be conducted by an independent body.

It also calls for freedom of speech and political freedom on campus, for the Campus Access Policy to be scrapped and for management to act on the referendum that called on the university to cut ties with Israeli institutions and weapons companies.

[Sign the open letter here. Isaac Nellist is a student at the University of Sydney and is running for Socialist Alliance in Balmain in the March 2027 election.]

title: London Conference's conclusions: Peace must be guaranteed by rule of law and democratic institutions
content:
Following the Peace and Democratic Integration Conference, held in London on September 29–30, the Centre for Kurdish Affairs published its conclusions from the conference discussions, along with recommendations for the period ahead.


During the two-day conference, representatives of Kurdish political and civil society organizations, as well as figures involved in peace processes in different parts of the world, academics, politicians, and experts came together. They discussed a wide range of topics, from the democratic resolution of the Kurdish issue in Turkey to international experiences of peacebuilding; from legal guarantees and local democracy to the role of women, as well as developments in Syria and the wider region.


The Centre for Kurdish Affairs stressed that "this communiqué presents the Centre’s analysis of the conference discussions. The views, interpretations and conclusions contained herein should not be understood as a collective statement on behalf of every speaker, participant or supporting institution."


The text said: "The Centre for Kurdish Affairs convened a two-day international conference in London, bringing together peace practitioners, academics, political representatives, policymakers and civil society representatives to examine comparative experiences of conflict resolution, peacebuilding, constitutional accommodation, power-sharing and self-government, and to consider their relevance to contemporary discussions concerning the Kurdish question.


For the purposes of this communiqué, democratic integration refers to rights-based and voluntary participation within a plural democratic order and should not be understood as cultural, linguistic or political assimilation. Furthermore, the phrase ‘the Kurdish question’ is employed to encompass the full spectrum of legal, political, cultural, economic, and social issues impacting Kurdish populations."


Summarizing the two-day conference, the text said: "The first day focused on comparative international experiences through three panels: ‘Why Peace Processes Succeed or Fail’; ‘Peace, Power-Sharing and Constitutional Accommodation: Lessons from the UK’; and ‘Autonomy, Devolution and Self-Government’. Drawing on a range of conflict-resolution and constitutional experiences, the discussions considered the political and institutional conditions under which negotiations can be sustained, settlements can acquire legitimacy and durability, and differing territorial and political claims can be accommodated within democratic frameworks.


The second day turned more directly to the Kurdish question through three panels: ‘Post-Conflict Kurdish Democratic Politics’; ‘The Kurdish Question Across Borders’; and ‘Inclusive Peace: Women, Minorities, and Systems of Justice’. The discussions examined the possible evolution of Kurdish politics in a post-conflict environment, the regional and transnational dimensions of the Kurdish question across Türkiye, Syria, Iraq and Iran, as well as within the diaspora, and the role of women, minorities and the media in broadening participation and embedding peace within democratic political life."


Conference Context and International Engagement


The text continued: "London offered a particularly resonant setting for these discussions. The United Kingdom’s constitutional tradition has evolved over many centuries, with Magna Carta of 1215 among its historic reference points in the development of law, political authority, representation and consent.


Its more recent experience of devolution, power-sharing and negotiated settlement provides a further point of reference for considering how established political systems can adapt to diverse identities and political aspirations. In this context, PDIC provided a forum for diplomatic and policy discussion in which Kurdish perspectives could be considered alongside wider international experience on conflict resolution, democratic accommodation and the prospects for a durable political settlement.


The conference received expressions of support and engagement from Catherine West MP, Bambos Charalambous MP and the Rt Hon David Lammy MP, underscoring the importance of sustained engagement between Kurdish perspectives and the United Kingdom’s political and policy community at a time when questions of peace, democratic participation and regional stability are assuming renewed significance.


The conference also received messages of encouragement from academics, intellectuals, civil …

author: Bruno Fonseca
title: Como o agro e o interior podem explicar diminuição de votos para Lula
content:
O domingo do primeiro turno terminou com uma surpresa, ao menos para quem acompanhava a maioria das pesquisas eleitorais e também para os próprios candidatos. “Confesso que estava convencido de que iria ganhar no primeiro turno”,

disse

 Lula ontem. O atual presidente marcou 3,3 milhões de votos a menos do que no primeiro turno de 2022, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro conseguiu 5 milhões de votos a mais que seu pai, Jair.


O resultado pode ser explicado por vários fatores: como a

Agência Pública


mostrou

,

escândalos políticos podem ter favorecido o desejo “antissistema” que – apesar de ser uma grande contradição –, é usado politicamente por Flávio e bolsonaristas.

 O caso do Master, inclusive, não foi capaz de impedir que muitos políticos diretamente citados nas investigações e vazamentos ligados ao banco

conseguissem

 se reeleger. Isso inclui o próprio Flávio, investigado por suspeitas de lavagem de dinheiro, corrupção e evasão de divisas em relação ao financiamento do filme Dark Horse, sobre seu pai. Flávio pediu dinheiro diretamente para Daniel Vorcaro, trocou dezenas de mensagens com o ex-banqueiro e marcou encontros com ele.


Além dos escândalos políticos, outras variáveis ajudam a entender a diminuição de votos de Lula e o crescimento de Flávio, e elas ficam evidentes no próprio mapa do Brasil. Levantamento de dados feito pelo cientista político Marco Antonio Faganello, pesquisador do Centro de Política e Economia do Setor Público da Fundação Getúlio Vargas (FGV/CEPESP), mostra que

Lula perdeu mais votos em municípios que não são capitais, e essa perda é ainda mais gritante em cidades menores onde a participação do agro na economia é grande.

 “Onde o agro está em mais de 50% no PIB, no conjunto, Lula perdeu 8% dos votos em relação a 2022”, aponta.


A análise de Faganello mostra que municípios pequenos do interior, com alto PIB per capita, proporção de moradores que se declaram brancos e jovens mais alta e com grande atividade agropecuária estão onde Lula mais perdeu votos proporcionalmente a 2022. É esse o tipo de perfil de vários municípios de Goiás, estado onde a diminuição dos votos para Lula foi a mais significativa na proporção com 2022.


O pesquisador também aponta que o Nordeste, apesar de ser um reduto tradicional de Lula e não ter registrado uma queda significativa nos votos para o atual presidente, foi onde Flávio mais avançou. “A direita cresceu nos nove estados do Nordeste. Flávio superou o resultado de Bolsonaro em 98% dos 1.794 municípios da região. No Nordeste, Lula perdeu poucos votos, mas a direita cresceu em todos os estados: de 27% para 30,9% dos votos válidos”, detalha.


Na entrevista, Faganello também avalia como a abstenção, apesar de ter sido recorde, não parece ter impactado a perda de votos de Lula no Brasil como um todo, com exceção de Salvador, onde a

ausência de eleitores

 impactou a votação do petista. Além disso, para o pesquisador, a proporção de evangélicos entre a população pode não explicar essa mudança. Contudo, Faganello ressalta que ainda há dados que o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral deve divulgar que podem detalhar esses aspectos.


Confira os principais trechos da entrevista aqui.


Marco Antonio Faganello é cientista político e pesquisador do Centro de Política e Economia do Setor Público da Fundação Getúlio Vargas (FGV/CEPESP)


Na sua análise, você conclui que Lula teve menos votos em 2026 em relação ao primeiro turno de 2022 em 98% dos municípios do Brasil. Mas isso aconteceu diferente nas cidades pequenas e nas capitais e também a partir de outros fatores, como atividade agropecuária. Você pode explicar melhor essa diferença?


Estamos falando em votação proporcional, isto é, no quanto os votos que foram para o Lula em 2022 aumentaram ou diminuíram em 2026, proporcionalmente.

Os dados mostram que essa queda foi maior sobretudo nos pequenos municípios e nos municípios ligados ao agro, além de ter um recorte por região do país. São esses os três principais fatores: tamanho, agro e região.


Sobre o tamanho dos municípios, quanto menor, mais Lula perdeu votos em relação a 2022. Nos municípios com até 5 mil habitantes, ele perde cerca de 7% [comparando 2026 a 2022]. Nos com mais de 500 mil habitantes, ele perde só 1%.


É importante ressaltar que isso é uma faceta, porque se você olha pra outro lado, em números absolutos, esse contingente de municípios pequenos não contribui tanto para a diminuição dos votos do Lula.

author: Unknown
title: AYM, Tayfun Kahraman kararının gerekçesini açıkladı, mahkemeyi uyardı: Yeniden yargılansın
content:
Anayasa Mahkemesi (AYM), Gezi Parkı davasında 18 yıl hapis cezasına çarptırılan Tayfun Kahraman’ın adil yargılanma ve bireysel başvuru haklarının ihlal edildiğine hükmederek yeniden yargılama yapılmasına ve Kahraman’a 100 bin TL manevi tazminat ödenmesine karar verdi. Kararı uygulamayan mahkemeyi uyaran AYM, "Kararların bağlayıcılığının sorgulanması ve uygulanmaması hukuk devletini işlemez hâle getirir, kaçınılmaz bir şekilde hukuk sistemini kaosa sürükler" dedi.

AYM, Temmuz 2025'te Kahraman'ın adil yargılanma hakkının ihlal edildiğine karar vermiş ve yeniden yargılama için kararı İstanbul 13. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi'ne göndermişti. Mahkeme, AYM'nin "yetki gasbı" yaptığını belirterek yeniden yargılama talebini reddetmişti. AYM, bu kez bireysel başvuru hakkının oybirliğiyle, hakkaniyete uygun yargılanma hakkının ise oyçokluğuyla ihlal edildiğine hükmetti ve yeniden yargılama için kararı aynı mahkemeye bir kez daha gönderdi. Kahraman’a ayrıca 100 bin TL manevi tazminat ödenmesine hükmedildi. Ödemenin Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığına başvurudan itibaren dört ay içinde yapılması, gecikme halinde yasal faiz uygulanması kararlaştırıldı.

Yeni Parti Grup Başkanvekili Gökhan Günaydın, AYM'nin kararının akıbeti benzer olan çok sayıda siyasi tutuklu için emsal teşkil ettiğini belirterek "Böylece Anayasa Mahkemesi, ilk derece mahkemesi niteliğindeki ağır ceza mahkemesine ve temyiz mercii olan Yargıtay’a bir kez daha Anayasa’yı hatırlatmış oldu" yorumunda bulundu.

author: Unknown
title: Akın Gürlek'in "muhatap almadığı" ve dava gerekçesi yaptığı Ahmet Şık soruları
content:
Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek'in avukatı Abdullah Adır, Türkiye İşçi Partisi (TİP) İstanbul Milletvekili Ahmet Şık'ın Gürlek'le ilgili iddialarını destekleyen belge sunmadığını savunarak, hakkında suç duyurusunda bulunulduğunu ve tazminat davası açıldığını bildirdi.

Adır'ın açıklaması şöyle: "TİP Milletvekili Ahmet Şık'ın daha önce dile getirdiği iddialara ilişkin kendisinden somut bilgi ve belge sunması istenmiş; ancak bugüne kadar iddialarını destekleyen tek bir belge dahi ortaya konulamamıştır. Dayanaktan yoksun ve gerçeği yansıtmayan paylaşımları nedeniyle hakkında suç duyurusunda bulunulmuş ve tazminat davası açılmıştır. İddiasını ispat edemeyen bu müptezelin iftira ve hakaretleri tarafımızca muhatap alınmamaktadır. Gerekli cevap yalnızca hukuk önünde verilecektir. Kamuoyuna saygıyla duyurulur."

Ahmet Şık, 26 Eylül'de X hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda "Akın Gürlek, tutuklu şüphelilerden E.Tezmen ve M.Yarız ile tutuksuz E. Özel ile Adalet Bakan Yardımcılığı döneminden bugüne kadar 2024, 2025, 2026'da İstanbul’daki belirli otellerde kaç kez görüşmüştür? Görüşmelerin tarihleri, yerleri, amaçları ve içerikleri nelerdir?" sorusunu sormuştu.

Şık ayrıca New York'taki BM Genel Kurulu sırasında çekilen bir fotoğrafı paylaşarak "Geçen hafta New York’taki BM toplantısı sırasında çekilen bu fotoğrafta, solda Akın Gürlek’in yanında duran kişi fon soygunu soruşturmasında hakkında yakalama kararı bulunan Bilal Çalışkan" demişti.

Ahmet Şık son olarak bugün Ahmet Saymadi'nin kendisiyle olan dostluğu ve ortaklığı yüzünden hedef alınarak tutuklandığını söyledi ve Gürlek'e şu soruları yöneltti:

“Off shore bağlantılı hesaplarla ilişkili sizin, sair akraba ve efradınız ile yakın çevrenizde bulunan bazı isimler üzerine yurtdışında kurulu tabela şirketleriniz var mı? Bu şirketler üzerinden 'yurtdışı yatırımcısı' perdelemesiyle fon soygunu soruşturmasında adı geçen portföy yatırım şirketlerinden yüklü miktarlarda işlemler yapılmış mıdır? Fon soygunu ortaya çıkmadan birkaç ay önce Tera Portföy yönetim şirketine manipülatif işlemler nedeniyle yaklaşık 9 milyon ceza kesen SPK yönetimi sonrasında bu vurgunu önleyici/denetleyici hiçbir işlem yapmadı. Eğer menfaat ilişkisi yoksa en hafifinden “görevi ihmal/kötüye kullanma” suçlamasından şüpheli olan ve bu tür soygunları önleyici/denetleyici kurum olan SPK yönetiminde eşiniz varken sizin soruşturmayı yürüten yargının başında olmanız çıkar çatışması değil midir? Fon soygunu soruşturmasının tutuklu şüphelileri Emre Tezmen, Muhammed Yarız ve Erdin Özel ile Adalet Bakan Yardımcılığı döneminden bugüne kadar 2024, 2025, 2026'da İstanbul’daki belirli otellerde görüştünüz mü? Görüşmelerin tarihleri, yerleri, amaçları ve içerikleri nelerdir? Yeni Parti Genel Başkanı Özgür Özel, üzerinize kayıtlı olduğunu öne sürdüğü 16 ayrı taşınmaz olduğunu açıkladı. Yaptığınız açıklamada 4 tapunuz olduğunu söylediniz. Ancak geçmişten bugüne kadar yaptığınız tüm taşınmaz alım satımların hepsini içere pasif tapu kayıtlarını açıklayacak mısınız? İlgili bakanlıktan bu pasif kayıtların silinmesini talep ettiniz mi? İlgili bakanlıktaki üst düzey yetkiliden “200 yıldır silinemedi dolayısıyla silinmesi imkânsız” yanıtı aldınız mı? Danışmanlığınızı yapan Furkan Torlak’ın, Mehmet Kap sahte kimliğiyle trol+medya manipülasyon çetesiyle birlikte işlediği suçlardan haberiniz var mı?”

author: Edith Romero
title: ICE Jail Policies for Pregnant People Built on Legacy of Eugenics, Critics Say
content:
A record number of pregnant women and teenagers have been arrested by ICE. They cannot access medical care they need.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

While detained at Michigan’s North Lake Processing Center, Lucia learned she was pregnant — a nightmare scenario for her and many other women who are held in Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) custody while pregnant.

“I prayed every day for God to take care of my little angel,” said Lucia, who is using a pseudonym for fear of retaliation and harm.

Originally from Venezuela, Lucia left the political turmoil of her home country in 2022 as the COVID-19 pandemic also abruptly ended her ability to study nursing.

“I left because I was looking for a better future,” she said.

She was in the U.S. for three years before the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) rescinded Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for multiple countries, including Venezuela, in February 2025. An ICE traffic stop that year in Detroit landed Lucia in detention, just weeks after her partner was also detained by ICE.

Lucia was transferred to four different detention centers before arriving at the South Louisiana Processing Center in Basile, Louisiana. She described her time there as “horrible.”

“I saw many high-risk pregnancies,” Lucia said.

Her own pregnancy was classified as high-risk due to a previous miscarriage. Lucia told Prism that she met dozens of pregnant women while in detention.

“I saw a woman who gave birth,” she said. “I saw her in a wheelchair with her newborn crying, and a nurse was taking her somewhere. I never saw her or her baby again.”

A recent investigation from The Guardian corroborated Lucia’s claims. ICE is arresting a record number of pregnant women and teenagers who cannot access the medical care they need, according to the reporting. At the same time, the agency appears to have lost count of how many people had miscarriages after October 2025.

In an emailed statement to Prism, a DHS representative said that “being in detention is a choice” and that “pregnancy in ICE detention is exceedingly rare.” The spokesperson also alleged that pregnant women receive regular prenatal visits, mental health services, and nutritional support.

“Claims that there are subprime conditions at ICE detention centers are false,” the representative said. “For many illegal aliens this is the best healthcare they have received their entire lives.”

According to experts and advocates, the racist cruelty and abusive immigration policies women in ICE detention face are built on a legacy of eugenics, an ideology that aimed to “improve” the human population based on white supremacy.

Often referred to as “Basile,” the South Louisiana Processing Center is the single women-only immigrant detention center in the state. In July, videos created by women detained at the facility went viral, exposing inhumane conditions and alleging sexual abuse.

Basile is located in rural Louisiana and has an extensive history of denying migrants access to food, interpreters, and medical care. The facility is 1 of 10 ICE detention centers in Louisiana, known as the “incarceration capital” of the U.S. for having the county’s highest rates of incarceration.

Documents from DHS released earlier this year further corroborated Lucia’s account of meeting a large number of pregnant women in detention.

According to government records, ICE detained approximately 498 pregnant, postpartum, or nursing immigrants between Jan. 1, 2025, and Feb. 16, 2026. The detention of pregnant people shows an alarming shift away from Biden-era policies that required their immediate release from federal custody.

Louisiana is often at the center of allegations of reproductive injustice in detention. Over the last year alone, detained women in the state have made serious allegations of medical neglect and sexual abuse. This includes the case of a Jane Doe, who alleged last year that she was sexually abused and threatened by Manuel Reyes, Basile’s former assistant warden. Trans immigrants have also alleged that Reyes “ran an off-the-books late-night work scheme” that coerced them into “physically and psychologically painful labor.”

For women detained at Basile, it can be difficult to separate fact from fiction, due to ICE’s extensive history of malpractice and dishonesty.

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Quebec election day goes smoothly in Nunavik, officials say
content:
Officials say voting in the Ungava riding during Quebec’s provincial election is unfolding with no issues — a stark contrast from the 2025 federal election.


Polling stations are open in every community in the region, with two elections officers in each community, said Élections Québec spokesperson Julie St-Arnaud-Drolet in an email on Monday.


From Sept. 26 to Sept. 30, the advance polling dates in Nunavik, election staff helped residents get on the electors list to participate in the election, she said.


Election staff also recruited and trained locals to run the election, she added.


“In most communities, they were able to hire local residents; as a result, voters have access to services in Inuktitut today, on election day,” she said.


Kuujjuaq deputy Mayor Claude Gadbois said the voting process was smooth in his community.


“Everything seems to be under control,” Gadbois told Nunatsiaq News over Facebook on Monday afternoon.


During the 2025 federal election, some

Nunavimmiut were unable to cast ballots

. On election day in April, polling stations in two communities did not open at all, while seven others had reduced hours.


Elections Canada released a report last November that said a lack of planning and almost no local outreach were responsible for the problems.


The polls for the 2026 provincial election close at 8 p.m. Monday. Five candidates are

running

 in Ungava, Quebec’s largest riding by geography.


Voters can cast their ballot from their village’s municipal office, except for those in Kuujjuaraapik, who must go to the community’s cultural centre.

title: “Μύρισε θάνατος στις Σκουριές”, Κάλεσμα της Επιτροπής Αγώνα της Μ. Παναγιάς και κάλεσμα σε συγκέντρωση τη Πέμπτη 8/10, ενόψει των εγκαινίων του μεταλλείου
content:
Ανακοίνωση της Επιτροπής Αγώνα Μεγάλης Παναγιάς και κάλεσμα σε συγκέντρωση την Πέμπτη 8/10, στις 09.00, στο Χοντρό δέντρο ενάντια στα εγκαίνια του μεταλλείου της El Dorado στις Σκουριές, που θα λάβουν χώρα την ίδια μέρα παρουσία του πρωθυπουργού Κυριάκου Μητσοτάκη.


(Χοντρό Δέντρο είναι η διασταύρωση πάνω στον κεντρικό, όπου ξεκινάει ο δρόμος που ανεβαίνει στο βουνό προς το μεταλλείο.)


Επιτροπή Αγώνα Μεγάλης Παναγιάς:


“Μύρισε θάνατος


Αφήστε μας να σας ξεναγήσουμε και πάλι στην παρακμοχώρα της ΒΑ χαλκιδικής, στο σκοτεινό βασίλειο των μεταλλείων της Εldorado, εκεί όπου οι δυνάμεις του σκότους έχουν συνομωτήσει για την κονόμα, ένας σκοπός για να τους ενώνει πάντα.


Κυρίες και κύριοι, για μία και μοναδική εμφάνιση, την Πέμπτη 8 Οκτωβρίου, στο εργοτάξιο των Σκουριών, τα μπαλέτα της Eldorado, θα παρουσιάσουν το ντεμπούτο τους:


“Εγκαίνια του μεταλλείου των Σκουριών ή Μύρισε Θάνατος”.


Την βρομερή δυσωδία θα πλαισιώσει στον ρόλο της πρίμα μπαλαρίνας, ο γνωστός για τις σκοτεινές του χορογραφίες, Κυριάκος Μητσοτάκης και οι χορευτές του. Σε ρόλο σαλτιμπάγκου γελωτοποιού ο δήμαρχος Βαλιάνος ενώ τους λοιπούς αυλικούς θα υποδυθούν οι ντόπιοι αιρετοί και κομματικοί παρατρεχάμενοι.


Το θέαμα περιλαμβάνει, εκτός από σεμινάρια του τύπου “μαθαίνω να γλείφω κοκαλάκια”, και ξεκοιλιασμένα δάση, στερευμένες πηγές, σκοτωμένους μεταλλωρύχους, χωριά ζόμπι, έρμαια στην διχόνοια και την ένοχη σιωπή, πεδία πια ψυχικής έρευνας και κοινωνικής παρακμής. Την μαγική ατμόσφαιρα ολοκληρώνει το πέπλο της αιωρούμενης αμιαντούχας σκόνης, που υπόσχονται ότι θα μας αγκαλιάσει απαλά σαν σάβανο.


Επειδή όμως οι παραστάσεις δεν έχουν ουσία χωρίς το ευρύ κοινό και η συγκεκριμένη θα παίζεται καθημερινά στις δικές μας ζωές, εμείς θα παραβρεθούμε και ας μην έχουμε εισιτήριο, γιατί η δικιά μας τέχνη είναι ο δρόμος, η αντίσταση και η αξιοπρέπεια. Γιατί ο αγώνας μας ενάντια στα μεταλλεία ήταν, είναι και θα είναι δίκαιος.


Δεν προσκυνάμε, δεν μετανιώνουμε, θα πολεμάμε για πάντα.


Ραντεβού στο Χοντρό δέντρο, την Πέμπτη 8 Οκτωβρίου, στις 9:00, για μια παράσταση που θα μας μείνει σε όλα αξέχαστη.


Επιτροπή αγώνα Μ. Παναγίας”


 


Κάλεσμα της

Επιτροπής Αγώνα Θεσσαλονίκης ενάντια στην εξόρυξη χρυσού:


Ο πρόεδρος της Hellas Gold, Χ. Μπαλάσκας, ανακοίνωσε στη ΔΕΘ τα εγκαίνια στις Σκουριές για τις 8 Οκτωβρίου.

Πήγαμε στο βουνό. Είδαμε το δάσος να υποχωρεί, το νερό να απειλείται. Νιώσαμε τη σκόνη, τον θόρυβο, την αλλαγή του τοπίου.

Και τώρα, μαζί με τις χρυσές κορδέλες, έρχονται οι εκρήξεις, η αποστράγγιση, η λειτουργία ενός έργου που θα αποτελέσει ταφόπλακα για τη ΒΑ Χαλκιδική και την ευρύτερη περιοχή.

Ανησυχούμε για τον αέρα που θα αναπνεύσουμε, για το νερό που έχουμε ανάγκη, για τον τόπο μας.

Την Πέμπτη, στις 9 το πρωί, στο Χονδρό Δέντρο, μαζί με τους κατοίκους της Μεγάλης Παναγίας.

Εμείς θα είμαστε εκεί.

Γιατί το βουνό είναι η ζωή μας.

author: Robert Whitaker
title: The New York Times Fails Our Veterans
content:
O

n September 28, the

NY Times

 published a

short article

titled “VA Institutes New Consent Requirements for Some Psychiatric Drugs.” While the article is of little lasting import, reviewing it does provide an opportunity to reveal how the newspaper constructed a story that is protective of the conventional narrative of helpful psychiatric drugs, and while doing so commits what can only be described as journalistic malpractice.


The Historical Context


The VA’s mandate, which will require VHA doctors to obtain written consent when prescribing antidepressants to veterans under 30 years of age, is simply the latest development—and a small development at that—in a much larger story that dates back to at least 2006, when the VA launched a focused suicide prevention effort.


Around that time, Veteran Health Administration facilities began regularly screening veterans for depression, PTSD and substance use. This screening naturally led to a steady increase in the percentage of veterans diagnosed with a psychiatric disorder and treated with psychiatric drugs.


This initiative was expected to decrease suicides in veterans. Instead, suicides among veterans accessing VHA facilities steadily rose. So too disability rates among veterans, which

more than doubled

from 2010 to 2024.


In response, there arose within the veteran community the feeling that this treatment paradigm—

screening plus drug treatment

—was doing great harm, and a smoldering protest against this “drugging of veterans” began to arise in many veterans groups.


The veteran who stepped up to spearhead the protest was Derek Blumke. Derek served 12 years in the United States Air Force and Michigan Air National Guard, and had his own experience of seeing his life becoming undone after being prescribed antidepressants. In 2017, he launched the

Veterans section

 on our Mad in America website. He worked for us as an editor for a period of time, and then he returned to working in various veterans organizations, where he continued to focus public attention on this issue of the “drugging” of veterans. He eventually joined with the Gruntstyle Foundation to launch a

War Cry For Change

 project to make this issue known to the public. Mad in America collaborated on this effort by publishing stories by veterans who had been diagnosed and medicated to the point that their lives fell apart.


Blumke and colleagues organized events in Michigan, Boston and elsewhere to advance their War Cry For Change, which in 2025 culminated with an event on

Capitol Hill.

 At these events, I was invited to speak about research related to the impact of antidepressants on the risk of suicide. The Capitol Hill event led to the introduction of the Written Informed Consent Act in the House of Representatives, with 35 veterans organizations stepping forward to support this legislation. That bill, which has yet to be voted on in the House, would require the VHA to obtain written informed consent for all major classes of psychiatric drugs.


War Cry for Change event on Capitol Hill. Photo by Leah Harris


As part of this effort, Blumke and his collaborators

pointed to OIG investigations

 that had found that VHA prescribers often failed to provide veterans with informed consent about psychiatric drugs. The right to informed consent is enshrined in U.S. law, and thus the

OIG reports

 documented a legal failure in VHA medical care.


While waiting for that legislation to proceed, Blumke and his fellow veterans urged the VA to remedy this failure without waiting for passage of the Written Informed Consent Act. The VA’s announcement on September 28 marked a small step forward in responding to the “informed consent” demands of the veterans groups.


The VA, beginning in 2027, will require veterans under age 30 to sign consent forms when prescribed antidepressants, or when veterans are prescribed opioids and benzodiazepines together. However, this requirement

falls short

of the demand present in the Written Informed Consent Act, which would require written consent for prescribing all classes of psychiatric drugs, with this requirement applying to veterans of all ages.


That is the larger story. It’s a story of veterans accessing VHA care being diagnosed with depression, or other psychiatric disorder, and prescribed psychiatric drugs at exceedingly high rates, with tragic outcomes: rising suicide and disability rates. author: Chris Walker
title: Vance Sees “Nothing Unusual” in Taxpayer-Funded Ads Promoting Trump
content:
Some critics have decried the ads as likely illegal, and potentially an impeachable offense.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Vice President JD Vance told reporters on Monday that he sees no problem with the campaign-style TV ads featuring President Donald Trump that are being produced using taxpayer dollars and airing ahead of the midterm elections.

In defending the ads, Vance compared them to informative government-funded commercials, like those that promoted the Affordable Care Act (ACA) during the Obama and Biden administrations. However, those ads provided information about enrollment, eligibility, and more, while the Trump ads in question primarily promote the president and attack his perceived political enemies.

“I don’t think there’s anything unusual or unorthodox about it,” Vance said, recognizing that “some people probably don’t like it.”

“But if you look at the message of those advertisements, they are not partisan; it’s not like we’re advocating for a particular candidate,” he added.

Vance also claimed the ads are “trying to tell a story about how great the United States of America is.”

JD Vance defends Trump's taxpayer-funded propaganda videos: "If you look at the message of those advertisements, they are not partisan, it's not like we're advocating for a particular candidate"

According to sources speaking to The New York Times with knowledge of how Trump’s ads were produced, the funding for the ads came from the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) budget. The ads have so far run on cable news networks, nationally broadcast sporting events, and other programs.

Federal law prohibits the use of taxpayer funds to produce promotional, overtly political material. Notably, some of the taxpayer-funded ads in question have featured audio of the president, then as a candidate, giving a stump speech during the 2024 presidential election.

The ads feature attacks on so-called “communists” and “Marxists” — terms Trump has errantly used to describe Democrats in the past. An upcoming ad also describes Trump in disturbingly glowing terms, and is reportedly entitled, “God made Trump.”

These ads include disclaimers at the bottom that read: “Paid for by the U.S. Government.”

Critics and observers have described the ads as political, not informational.

“The timing cannot be ignored: five weeks ahead of congressional elections in which Republicans fear defeat in the House and the Senate,” CNN senior political reporter Stephen Collinson said. “The video’s hero narrative is exactly the kind of messaging that might drive out quintessential Trump voters whom the GOP needs to turn out in droves, even when Trump isn’t formally heading midterm tickets.”

The TV spots likely run afoul of federal laws forbidding the use of taxpayer funds for political advertising, others have noted. One former White House ethics lawyer, Richard Painter, pointed out that it may be an impeachable offense.

“This is very dangerous. We do not allow government-sponsored propaganda in the United States,” Painter said last month.

author: Duda Sousa
title: Aposta online: 12 dos 17 parlamentares da Bancada das Bets seguem mais 4 anos no Congresso
content:
Esta reportagem é parte de uma investigação especial da

Agência Pública

 financiada pelos nossos Aliados, sem nenhum dinheiro de bet. Apoie mais reportagens como essa

clicando aqui.


Um total de 70% dos parlamentares mapeados pela

Agência Pública

 como integrantes ou aliados da “Bancada das Bets” segue com mandatos no Congresso Nacional até 2030.

Dos 17 nomes identificados na investigação como parlamentares que contemplaram interesses das casas de apostas ou foram aliados importantes nas articulações desse mercado, 11 foram eleitos no último domingo (4)

. Um deles, Romário (PL-RJ), só enfrenta nova disputa por eleitores na próxima disputa para o Senado.


A

bancada

, que não existe formalmente no Congresso, reúne parlamentares que atuaram em pautas relacionadas à regulamentação, tributação e expansão do mercado de apostas online.


A influência do setor não se restringia à apresentação ou votação de projetos: passava também por conversas diretas com líderes partidários

, articulações para alterar propostas em tramitação e encontros com representantes e empresários do mercado, como revelado no especial

Jogo Perigoso: O Brasil das Bets

.


Entre os 11 parlamentares classificados como nomes de base que, direta ou indiretamente, contemplaram interesses das casas de apostas, sete foram eleitos. Luiz Philippe de Orleans e Bragança, foi reeleito pelo PL em São Paulo. Kim Kataguiri, que mudou do União Brasil para o Missão, também conquistou uma vaga pelo estado. Em Minas Gerais, Weliton Prado foi reeleito pelo PSD com 129.366 votos.


Na Bahia, Adolfo Viana (PSDB) foi reeleito com 119.865 votos e João Bacelar (PL), com 107.232. O outro Bacelar da lista, João Carlos Bacelar Batista, concorreu pelo PV e ficou de fora dos vitoriosos, mesmo obtendo 102.654 votos. Em Roraima, Gabriel Mota (União-RR), conquistou vaga com 10.195 votos. Na Paraíba, Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL) e Hugo Motta (Republicanos), presidente da Câmara, também foram reeleitos.


Dos seis parlamentares identificados pela

Pública

 como “líderes da Bancada das Bets”, além de Motta, outros três foram eleitos: Doutor Luizinho (PP-RJ), Isnaldo Bulhões (MDB-AL) e Felipe Carreras (PSB-PE), que renovaram seus mandatos na Câmara.


Seguem no Congresso


							–


A atuação dos quatro foi destacada em diferentes momentos da investigação. Luizinho e Bulhões foram identificados como articuladores de iniciativas para impedir aumento da tributação das apostas. A dupla também participou das articulações que retiraram a Cide-bets, contribuição de 15% prevista no debate do PL Antifacção, do texto aprovado pela Câmara. Felipe Carreras, por sua vez, foi descrito por interlocutores ouvidos pela reportagem como um dos principais nomes procurados pelo setor, enquanto Hugo Motta foi citado nas negociações que levaram à retirada da Cide-bets.


Dois dos principais nomes ligados às casas de apostas online, no entanto, ficaram pelo caminho.

 Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), que disputou a reeleição ao Senado, terminou em terceiro lugar, com 24,68% dos votos, atrás de Marcelo Castro (MDB) e Júlio César (PSD). O mesmo ocorreu com Ângelo Coronel (Republicanos-BA), que teve 2.898.885 votos, 20,11% dos válidos, e ficou atrás de Rui Costa e Jaques Wagner, ambos do PT baiano.


Além dos dois, três nomes da Bancada das Bets não chegaram a tentar uma renovação de mandato:

Jorge Kajuru (PSB-GO), e Irajá (PSD-TO) ficaram fora das urnas e encerram o mandato nos próximos meses.


Saem do Congresso


							–


Correndo por fora


Nomes importantes dos bastidores da costura desse setor na Câmara, que não compunham diretamente a bancada, mas influenciam nas suas conquistas também tiveram desempenho irregular no pleito de 2026.

Arthur Lira (PP-AL) deixou a Câmara depois de mais de uma década e conquistou uma das duas vagas de Alagoas no Senado, com 946.970 votos, 28,87% dos válidos. Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE) foi reeleito senador por Sergipe, com 509.608 votos.


Enquanto isso, Efraim Filho tentou, sem sucesso, a cadeira do governo da Paraíba pelo PL. Já Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) não chegou a ir às urnas, uma vez que seu mandato no Senado segue até 2030.

title: “People-First Foreign Policy Pledge” Signed by National Organizations, Foreign Policy Experts Urges All Congressional Candidates to Back Three Common-Sense Positions
content:
By the undersigned organizations, including World BEYOND War, October 5, 2026


Washington, DC — A just released People-First Foreign Policy Pledge is calling on Congressional candidates of all parties to commit to three popular, common sense foreign policy positions if they want to win a midterm election and deliver the change people want and need.


The Pledge, which has been signed by dozens of national organizations and foreign policy experts, urges candidates to:


1. End the Iran War and All Endless Wars.


2. Cut the Pentagon Budget and Abolish ICE.


3. Stop All Arms and Other Support for Israel and Other Human Rights Violators.


The Pledge notes these positions are broadly popular across party lines and will “advance the safety, security, and well-being of people” in the United States and globally.


Supporting these positions will help the country break from a status quo that has “killed, injured, and displaced tens of millions, squandered trillions of tax dollars, and caused devastating environmental damage.”


Signatories include national organizations such as About Face: Veterans Against the War, Rising Majority, American Friends Service Committee, RootsAction, Dissenters, National Iranian American Council, Madre, US Campaign for Palestinian Rights Action, World BEYOND War, Veterans for Peace, among others.


Individual signatories include foreign policy experts such as Dr. Van Jackson, Phyllis Bennis, Dr. Khury Petersen-Smith, Dr. Ivan Eland, Col. (Ret) Lawrence Wilkerson, Dr. Miriam Pemberton, Norman Solomon, Dr. Nikhil Pal Singh, Jose Vasquez, Dr. Heidi Peltier, and John Cavanagh.


“Being opposed to endless wars and masked federal agents kidnapping people off of our streets are now firmly bipartisan issues,” commented Brittany DeBarros, Organizing Director of About Face: Veterans Against the War. “The people …want candidates that actually represent our ideals, and it’s time for politicians to get with the program if they want our support.”


“As polling shows, voters are way ahead of officeholders on crucial issues of war and human rights,” said Pledge signatory Norman Solomon, national director of RootsAction and author of War Made Invisible. “Candidates would be wise to catch up.”


By committing to end endless US wars, cut the budgets of the Pentagon and ICE, and stop US support for Israel and other human rights abusers, the Pledge says, “Congressional candidates can adopt winning positions and help transform our country into one we can be proud of.”


The Pledge stresses it is just the beginning of the change our foreign policy needs to put people first, not war profiteers. In explaining why he signed, Dr. Van Jackson, a former Obama administration official and foreign policy expert, wrote, “No peace, no democracy or equality. A people’s foreign policy is one that addresses what ails the people—economic insecurity, racial and wealth inequality, and an unaccountable machinery of warmaking.”


The Pledge’s full text and initial signatories are below and at www.peoplesforeignpolicy.us.


The People-First Foreign Policy Pledge


There are three foreign policy positions that all Congressional candidates, regardless of party, should pledge to support if they want to win a midterm election and deliver the change people in the US want and need.


Each is common sense, with broad support across Democrats, Republicans, and independents. Each prioritizes the safety, security, and well-being of our country and the world over those profiting off war. Each breaks from a status quo that has killed, injured, and displaced tens of millions, squandered trillions of tax dollars, and caused devastating environmental damage. The three positions are:


1. End the War in Iran and All Endless Wars.


2. Cut the Pentagon Budget and Abolish ICE.


3. Stop All Aid to Israel and Other Human Rights Violators.


End the War in Iran and All Endless Wars.


Transforming our country’s future begins with ending the disastrous, illegal war on Iran and the endless wars that have hijacked the nation since 2001. author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Sanikiluaq daycare moves so facility can expand
content:
Sanikiluaq’s daycare is moving as renovations begin on the community’s existing child-care facility.


Starting Oct. 26, the daycare will move into a temporary space at Nuiyak elementary school, according to an Oct. 1 update that the Sanikiluaq

 District Education Authority posted on Facebook.


The DEA initially told families the daycare building would be demolished Oct. 25 to make way for a new facility.


“We wish to clarify that the daycare is closing to allow for renovations,” said Tyler Kraft, the DEA’s office manager, in a statement posted to Facebook on Monday.

“We recognize that the incorrect information may have caused concern and confusion among families, staff, and community members.”


“We regret this error and any distress it may have caused,” he said.


The project involves renovations to expand the number of licensed child-care spaces, said Kuthula Matshazi, director of stakeholder engagement for the Department of Education, Sept. 29 in an email to Nunatsiaq News.


Construction is scheduled to begin Oct. 25 and is supported by early learning and child-care infrastructure funding from the federal government.


The department did not provide a cost estimate for the project.


The renovation is expected to be complete by Sept. 1, 2027, Matshazi said.


The daycare is currently licensed for four infant spaces and 16 preschool spaces. The renovated facility is expected to add two infant spaces and eight preschool spaces, bringing the total to six infant spaces and 24 preschool spaces, Matshazi said.


Kraft had previously said in an interview that 12 children were on the waitlist to enrol at the daycare.


The temporary location at Nuiyak School will allow daycare services to continue during renovations, ensuring the seven employees — six full-time and one part-time — can continue working.


The larger facility would also allow the daycare to hire more staff and include technology intended to support early education, Kraft said.

author: dev
title: Des cauchemars et des rêves
content:
« M'sieur, si on aime foutre le bordel c'est qu'on s'ennuie tellement sinon »


« m'sieur, ma grande sœur elle a failli se faire taper par un flic, ils font trop peur en vrai »


« m'sieur, si les adultes sont gentils, on est gentil avec eux »


« m'sieur mon grand frère il dit que y'a que avec le feu que l'on se fait entendre »


« m'sieur c'est trop bien ce qu'il se passe »


« m'sieur, on passe plus de temps à travailler au collège qu'avec nos parents ou nos amies, c'est pas normal. »


L'apathie était l'humeur écrasante. Sans trop y croire, nous nous attachions à des appels au 17 octobre contre la vie chère, à un énième retour tant attendu des Gilets jaunes, parfois nous participions à des manifs ou des évènements sans fougue juste pour aller boire un coup, nous regardions sur nos écrans défiler les images aberrantes de la guerre capitaliste menée contre un « nous » toujours plus grand. Bref, en France, depuis les Gilets jaunes, nous étions en attente, traversés parfois d'espoirs qu'on savait d'avance déçus. Nous regardions atterrés la suite du monde se dessiner comme un cauchemar dont on ne sait plus par où se réveiller. Et là, contre toute attente, les lycéens soulèvent l'ordre morose. Un soulèvement de la jeunesse : qui l'eût cru ?


Ces « jeunes » qu'on ne cesse de dépeindre comme dépolitisés, rivés à ces fameux écrans, incapables de réfléchir et de s'organiser, etc... En une semaine, partie de la banlieue parisienne avant de s'étendre sur tout le territoire, une jeunesse en révolte affole le pouvoir. Ça y est nous nous remettons quelque peu à entrevoir quelques rêves de révolte, et la bourgeoisie, elle, commence à cauchemarder :

« alertes info - BFMTV - le premier ministre craint que la crise lycéenne ne s'installe pendant plusieurs mois, voire jusqu'à la présidentielle. Ses conseillers, dont plusieurs anciens préfet,observent une convergence des luttes jugée inédite entre des jeunes de banlieue et de centre ville,issus de milieux sociaux très différents. »

 Leurs cauchemars sont nos rêves. On y reviendra à cette histoire de mélange des classes sociales dans la jeunesse ; comme une possibilité de débordement majeur ou comme une faille dont le pouvoir va se servir pour mater le soulèvement. Il n'y a pas qu'à l'école qu'on a des camarades de classe.


Est-ce que les énièmes réunions de crises ministérielles, l'habituel ronron médiatique contre les fameux

« débordements menés par des agents extérieurs »

 - qui évidement et encore une fois ne sont pas des débordements mais la raison de l'affolement du pouvoir – est-ce que donc ces techniques contre insurrectionnelles auront raison de cette révolte si attendue ? Car la technique contre insurrectionnelle n'est pas qu'une répression brutale des corps qui débordent, mais aussi une pression sur l'esprit de celles et ceux qui pourraient rejoindre ces débordements... Nous voilà donc seriner à longueur de journée à la bonne vielle recette : tout les récits sont fait pour séparer les « bon-lycéens-gentils-respectables-aux-revendications-légitimes » et « les-méchants-lycéens-casseurs-éléments-extérieurs etc... »


Imaginez un instant que dans un autre endroit lointain de nos démocraties, un soulèvement de la jeunesse soit réprimé férocement, que plus de 5000 arrestations aient lieu en 5 jours, que des interdictions de manifester tombent et que les dirigeants au pouvoir de cet endroit du monde lointain ne parlent que du fait que les incidents sont le fait d'agents extérieurs : vous y sentirez l'arnaque à pleins nez et vous auriez bien raison. Mais c'est plus difficile de s'en rendre compte quand ce sont nos rues qui crament.


Ce texte ne veux pas re-re-re-re-re-dire les conditions aberrantes de l'éducation nationale, les manques de moyens, les classes surchargées, parcours sup, etc... car l'essentiel de ce mouvement me semble parler de choses plus profondément radicales. Ce texte ne veux pas parler à la place de quiconque mais se veut comme une défense de ce qu'il se passe, comme une alliance avec elleux. Une ode et un appel à rejoindre cette jeunesse, au-delà de nos âges et de nos fonctions. Pas depuis un extérieur analysant, mais depuis une intuition qui nous attire vers le fond et la forme que prend cette révolte ; depuis ces fameux débordements qui sont tout sauf à la marge, qui en sont l'ADN et qui disent une chose simple « la révolution est possible, joyeuse, désirable et nécessaire »


Il est 10H00, il y a des centaines de jeunes éparpillés mais qui avancent …

author: Unknown
title: Эррико Малатеста - Как некоторые республиканцы не хотят делать Республику
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Как некоторые республиканцы не хотят делать Республику

Дата

: 15 ноября 1924

Источник

: Pensiero e Volontà №22


КАК НЕКОТОРЫЕ РЕСПУБЛИКАНЦЫ

НЕ ХОТЯТ ДЕЛАТЬ РЕСПУБЛИКУ


 Под заголовком «Как будет сделана республика» республиканский орган

La Bandiera

 в Риме писал в своём первом номере:


Республиканцы не хотят навязывать свои идеи насилием и произволом. Они хотят убедить Народ, что с Республикой будут решены главнейшие проблемы экономической, социальной и политической жизни сегодняшней Италии.


Не бесцельные бунты, не насилие против людей, не диктатуры политиканов и произвола.


Республиканцы утверждают, что Народ должен избрать

 Учредительное собрание

, составленное из представителей всех классов, всех идей, всех течений, всех интересов.


Учредительное собрание


решит, как должна быть устроена Италия: должна ли Италия быть

 монархией

или

 республикой

; Учредительное собрание даст

 основные

законы новой итальянской жизни.


Так, то есть через цивилизованную встречу всех существующих в нашей стране течений; так, цивилизованным средством принятия решений.


Так: как делали все народы, когда хотели закрыть мучительный период своей жизни.


Итальянские граждане, серьёзно озабоченные благом Нации, пусть подумают, что нет иного пути, чтобы избавить Италию от новых траурных утрат и новых разрушений.


 А мы хотели бы знать, принимают ли республиканцы – те, что в официальной партии, и те, что вне партии, старые и молодые, – эту программу или нет.


 Вопрос будет нескромным, но он, несомненно, имеет непосредственную актуальность теперь, когда Республика представляется возможным, и несомненно не худшим, решением итальянского кризиса [речь идет об убийстве депутата Матеотти, из-за которого режим Муссолини едва не рухнул].


 Мы, как известно, не республиканцы; но, будучи непримиримыми антимонархистами, нам важно знать, есть ли в Италии республиканцы, которые

хотят

 действительно сделать республику, или речь идёт только о литературных республиканцах, которые затем кончают, один за другим, как Каппа и Бардзилаи [приняли пост министра в королевском правительстве].


 Поскольку нам представляется очевидным, что если бы Республику пришлось делать на манер

La Bandiera

, то не только не была бы сделана Республика, но была бы оказана благоуханная услуга Монархии.


 И чтобы доказать это, нам было бы достаточно аргументов, которые используют сами республиканцы, когда ведут пропаганду. Тем, кто говорит, что монархия необходима, потому что народ ещё недостаточно образован, они отвечают, – и так отвечал их учитель Мадзини, – что Монархия не воспитывает, а развращает; что именно Республика создаст республиканцев; что именно со свободой приобретается потребность, вкус, способность быть свободными. И действительно, после более чем шестидесяти лет конституционной, национальной, либеральной и так далее Монархии, в Италии меньше республиканцев и особенно меньше республиканского духа, чем в десятилетие 1860–70 годов.


 А теперь эти республиканцы открывают, или надеются, что Собрание, составленное из «представителей всех классов, всех идей, всех течений, всех интересов», даст Италии Республику!.. Готовые, впрочем, подчиниться Монархии, если так решит Учредительное собрание.


 Не следует ли скорее предвидеть, что в собрании, составленном так, как говорит программа

La Bandiera

, восторжествуют самые сильные интересы, те течения, которые меньше всего задевают мизонеизм [боязнь нового] и естественную любовь людей к спокойной жизни, партии, за которыми стоит вооружённая сила, классы, владеющие богатством и знанием?


 И разве не несомненно, с другой стороны, что избранное собрание, хотя бы и без материального насилия, в тех моральных и экономических условиях, в которых находится итальянский народ, – далеко от того, чтобы представлять справедливо все идеи и все интересы, – было бы составлено в огромном большинстве из собственников, священников, адвокатов и политиканов и не представляло бы по существу ничего, кроме интересов тех, кто уже пользуется теперь всеми экономическими и политическими привилегиями?


 И в каком же учебнике истории видели эти республиканцы, что

народы делали всё так

, то есть «закрывали мучительные периоды своего существования через цивилизованную встречу»?... Разве что под

цивилизованной встречей

 они не подразумевают ружейные выстрелы, покушения, военные путчи и подобные милости!


 Нет, пусть убедятся друзья-республиканцы: если они хотят сделать республику …

title: Far Right Makes Gains in Brazil in First Round of Presidential Race
content:

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Brazil’s presidential election is headed to a runoff between leftist incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after neither candidate cleared 50% in Sunday’s vote, in which the right made gains in Congress and in governor races across the country. Bolsonaro received 47% of the vote compared to Lula’s 45%. The second round of voting is on October 25. If elected, Flávio Bolsonaro has vowed to grant amnesty to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest and serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup in 2022 to overturn Lula’s last victory. He has also vowed to strengthen ties to the Trump administration, which is accused of trying to influence the result in Bolsonaro’s favor.

“The momentum has been with the right since 2018,” says Brazilian philosopher Rodrigo Nunes, who explains that public disillusionment with politics is part of that shift. “Lots of people see the far right as promising them, ‘Well, if this is all there is, if all we can expect from the future is ever more dog-eat-dog conditions, an ever more competitive struggle of all against all, at least what the far right says is the state will get off our backs.’”

Nunes is author of Neither Vertical nor Horizontal: A Theory of Political Organization and the new book Anatomy of Disintegration: What Brazil Reveals About the Global Far Right. He recently wrote about the stakes of the Brazilian election for North South Notes.

Bolsonaro is the son of Brazil’s former far-right President Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest serving a 27-year sentence after he was convicted of plotting a military coup in 2022 to overturn Lula’s win in that year’s election. If elected, Flávio Bolsonaro has pledged to grant amnesty to his father and others involved in the coup. Flávio has also vowed to strengthen ties to the Trump administration.

In Senate races, Bolsonaro’s party secured 19 of the 54 Senate seats up for grabs. In total, the right or far right won 34 seats. Flávio Bolsonaro spoke to supporters in the capital Brasília.

SEN. FLÁVIO BOLSONARO: [translated] I am very happy about the real possibility that three weeks from now Brazil will give a definitive answer that it wants a modern government, a government with fewer ministries, a government that will restore democracy. What I have to say is that Lula is fighting for power. He has already contested seven presidential elections. Seven presidential elections. He is concerned about power. I am concerned about Brazil’s future. I am fighting for Brazil.

AMY GOODMAN: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva addressed supporters in São Paulo.

PRESIDENT LUIZ INÁCIO LULA DA SILVA: [translated] The result is unexpected. We never get everything we want. I must admit that I was convinced that I was going to win on the first round. … But we have the second round, and the runoff is the moment of truth. It’s time to show the true Brazilian picture, because today is the Brazil we want. So, starting tomorrow, we’re launching a new campaign.

AMY GOODMAN: Ahead of the elections, a group of 31 Democratic lawmakers sent a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, accusing the Trump administration of being engaged in a, quote, “sustained, multifaceted campaign of interference and destabilization in Brazil,” unquote.

We go now to Rio de Janeiro, where we’re joined by Rodrigo Nunes. His new book, out this week, Anatomy of Disintegration: What Brazil Reveals About the Global Far Right. author: Sophia Sheera
title: Burnham Scraps Starmer-Era Plans to Roll Back Jury Trials
content:
Andy Burnham’s government has scrapped plans to curb jury trials, after months of outcry from lawyers, MPs and the public. 


New justice secretary Alex Norris said on Sunday that his government inherited a court system “on the brink of collapse” – but that the answer to driving down backlogs was not to roll back jury trials. 


He added that scrapping the plans, which were introduced by former justice secretary David Lammy under Keir Starmer, would enable the Ministry of Justice to find better ways of addressing the courts backlog. 


“

I have heard the strength of feeling on the proposals for increasing the number of judge-alone trials in the Crown Court and have made the decision to change course,” he said. 


The government has instead promised to invest millions in new technology to modernise the sluggish courts system and give greater resources to judges.


Campaign group Defend Our Juries said the move was “a step in the right direction”. The group has argued Lammy’s plans were a deliberate attempt to stop protesters being acquitted by juries who believe they acted on their conscience when breaking certain laws.  


But the group criticised the government for

 announcing that courts

 will “have the final say over where cases should be heard” in order to prevent “criminals accused of relatively minor crimes trying to game the system by electing a jury trial in an attempt to avoid prison.” 


“The centuries-old democratic principle of trial by a jury of one’s peers is not an attempt to ‘game the system’”, the

group said

 on X.


The justice ministry has also said it will give magistrates the power to hand out longer sentences under the new plans. 


Last month, the Crown Court backlog reached a record high, with 81,000 cases awaiting trial and a third of them for longer than a year. 


Lammy’s plans would have meant cases where the sentence is less than three years would not be tried by jury. They also called for lengthy fraud and financial cases to be tried by only a judge, a policy that Norris will keep.


Critics of Lammy’s plans included

39 of Starmer’s own Labour bankbenchers

 and

Shami Chakrabarti

, former director of advocacy group Liberty Shami Chakrabarti. 


“The drastic restriction of the right to trial by jury is not a silver bullet,” the rebel MPs wrote in a letter to Starmer last December. “To limit a fundamental right for what will make a marginal difference to the backlog, if any, is madness and will cause more problems than it solves.”

author: CMI Argentina
title: Dos policías bonaerenses a juicio por apremios ilegales contra un joven
content:
La Cámara de Apelación y Garantías en lo Penal de Azul confirmó la elevación a juicio de la causa que tiene como imputados a los policías bonaerenses Brian Nahuel Ríos y Agustín Villarreal, por la violenta y desproporcionada intervención que desencadenó la muerte de Nahuel Tasori, ocurrida en julio de 2023 en la ciudad de Tandil. Los policías llegan imputados por el delito de apremios ilegales, por haber golpeado y rociado con gas pimienta a la víctima cuando ya estaba reducida y esposada. A pesar del evidente estado de excitación por el consumo de estupefacientes, Tasori fue trasladado a la comisaría donde estuvo alojado durante varias horas hasta que lo llevaron al hospital donde finalmente murió. La Comisión Provincial por la Memoria (CPM), en su carácter de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura, participa en la causa como particular damnificado institucional (PDI).


El fallo de la Cámara de Apelación y Garantías en lo Penal de Azul –integrada por los magistrados Damián Pedro Cini, Carlos Paulino Pagliere y Gustavo Agustín Echevarría- llega como respuesta al recurso de apelación interpuesto por la defensora particular Noelia Soledad Pereyra, para quien la elevación a juicio dictada el pasado 10 de junio por el juez de garantías de Tandil José Alberto Moragas es una resolución arbitraria, infundada y lesiva de las garantías constitucionales de defensa en juicio.


El hecho que se ventila en esta causa ocurrió durante la madrugada del 28 de julio de 2023, cuando una mujer (cuya identidad no se reveló) llamó al 911 denunciando que un ladrón había saltado un paredón de un domicilio particular en la intersección de las calles Pasaje y Segundo Sombras de Tandil.


El llamado dio origen al arribo de un patrullero de servicio en el que se trasladaban Villarreal y Ríos. Cuando llegaron al lugar el presunto ladrón ya había sido reducido en el piso por los propios vecinos, que se habían alarmado con los gritos y los ruidos esa madrugada. Luego de esposar al joven, mientras intentaban introducirlo en el móvil policial uno de los agentes le dio un fuerte golpe de puño y el otro le roció la cara con gas pimienta, sin ninguna circunstancia de peligro inminente que amerite el uso de la fuerza física o la violencia.


Al momento de la aprehensión, Nahuel estaba en un estado de alteración y excitación por el consumo de estupefacientes. Pese a que sus síntomas eran evidente, los funcionarios policiales no aplicaron los protocolos para la intervención en casos de salud mental y adicciones, que consistían en convocar a personal de la salud para su intervención. Por el contrario, lo trasladaron esposado a la comisaría donde quedó alojado durante varias horas. A medida que pasaba el tiempo, el estado de Nahuel fue empeorando y cuando decidieron llevarlo al hospital ya era demasiado tarde: falleció a poco de ingresar.


Desde el comienzo, la instrucción judicial -a cargo del fiscal José Calonje- se centró en el accionar violento de Villarreal y Ríos en el momento de la aprehensión, pero sin ahondar en la responsabilidad de cuidado que tenían sobre la víctima que estaba bajo su custodia. De hecho, tanto en la elevación a juicio solicitada por el juez Moragas como en el reciente fallo de la Cámara, la muerte de la víctima apenas aparece mencionada, a pesar que ocurrió en el contexto de la aprehensión y debió considerarse que, con la atención profesional y medicación adecuada, podría haberse evitado.


Para la CPM –que participa de la causa como particular damnificado institucional (PDI)- el caso reviste mayor gravedad aún si se considera que el joven aprehendido violentamente fue llevado a una comisaría que ni siquiera tenía calabozos y allí fue mantenido durante horas en lugar de trasladarlo directamente a un centro de salud mental, considerando el notorio estado de excitación psicomotriz en que se encontraba.


Sin atender a esta responsabilidad policial por las personas que están bajo su custodia, la defensa de los policías intentó incluso recurrir la elevación a juicio por la imputación de apremios ilegales. Entre los ejes del planteo para solicitar el sobreseimiento, se destacaban una errónea valoración de la prueba, las presuntas contradicciones que afectarían la credibilidad de la única testigo de la conducta agresiva y la falta de valoración de evidencias que favorecen la posición de los policías imputados, entre otros aspectos.


Sin embargo, por mayoría de votos, los jueces Echevarría y Cini rechazaron el planteo …

author: Ed Wanderley
title: O tempo das bets e a hora da luta: a perda familiar que não está em jogo no STF
content:
Esta reportagem é parte de uma investigação especial da

Agência Pública

 financiada pelos nossos Aliados, sem nenhum dinheiro de bet. Apoie mais reportagens como essa

clicando aqui.


O tempo é uma das ferramentas mais poderosas de perspectiva. Em apenas um segundo, as plataformas de apostas online ganharam mais dinheiro do que 33 milhões de brasileiros fizeram em um mês no ano passado. Literalmente.

Por cada segundo de 2025, as famílias brasileiras perderam para as bets R$ 1.982, mais do que o salário mínimo atual, de R$ 1.621

 – uma realidade, por exemplo, de três a cada cinco trabalhadores no Maranhão. 


Os dados são do Comitê Nacional de Secretários de Fazenda dos Estados e do Distrito Federal (Comsefaz), que, em agosto deste ano, estimou o esvaziamento do orçamento das famílias em R$ 62,5 bilhões em 2025 – um mercado cuja hora de “trabalho” ficou acima dos R$ 7 milhões. Na política, é justamente o tempo que muitas vezes dita urgência, relativização ou esquecimento.


Por quase uma hora, uma mulher se mantinha encolhida em um sofá na sala do apartamento da família em Uberlândia (MG). Era 25 de setembro. Em silêncio absoluto, cortado apenas por um respiro ansiosamente pesado. O som da TV preenchia o ambiente embalando a mulher, seu marido e sua filha mais velha. Evitavam falar, talvez até se mexer. As próprias vidas em suspenso.


O relógio marcava exatamente 19h07 quando um misto de riso, lágrimas e alívio tomou conta de seu semblante. Na tela, o presidente da República

assinava

 a Medida Provisória (MP)

1.394/25

, que proibia não apenas a propaganda, mas o funcionamento das plataformas de apostas em todo o território nacional. 


Ao longo dos sete minutos seguintes, viu Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, com quem havia se encontrado dias antes em Brasília, endossar o discurso que ela ajudou a popularizar, ao comparar a jogatina ao crack, e classificar a

ludopatia

 por jogos online como um risco ainda mais invasivo.

“O país trouxe o jogo para dentro de casa. O cassino está na sala, o cassino está na cozinha”, disse antes de citá-la “eu conversei com a ‘mãe que perdeu o filho de 26 anos’”.

 E ela sorriu, sem se incomodar com a alcunha.


“Foi uma sensação de dever cumprido”, resumiu a professora Vânia Borges do Amaral, de 54 anos, emocionada, ao ver sentido em compartilhar o luto de seu filho, Rafael Borges do Amaral, que tirou a própria vida após perder todas as economias acumuladas para as bets. É o mais recente marco na linha do tempo interrompida pela última aposta que o rapaz fez, à 1h48 de 23 de março de 2024 – um novo capítulo de sua história, agora provido de sentido.


Professora Vânia segura a foto de seu filho Rafael


A MP das bets determinou o fim da oferta dos jogos online, tanto em ambientes físicos quanto virtuais, abrangendo concessões federais e estaduais. Loterias tradicionais não foram atingidas pela mudança.

 Na prática, os sites e aplicativos das empresas devem ser retirados do ar nesta terça-feira (6) e as publicidades, mesmo em outdoors e outros meios físicos devem ser removidos. As multas pelo descumprimento da regra podem chegar a R$ 2 bilhões.


Não há previsão de indenização para as empresas detentoras das 85 outorgas para explorar a atividade legalmente desde 2023 no país. Cada outorga custou cerca de R$ 30 milhões, o que significa um investimento de R$ 2,55 bilhões por parte das companhias para ofertar plataformas reguladas no Brasil – valor quase 25 vezes inferior ao montante gasto pelas famílias em bets apenas em 2025.

Estudo da Universidade de São Paulo (USP) estima que as plataformas retiraram R$ 141 bilhões do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) nacional, enquanto renderam R$ 9,9 bilhões em tributos em contrapartida.


“Eu não imaginava que chegaria a esse ponto, porque quando eu comecei essa luta, eu fui recebida com muito descaso. Primeiro pela Polícia Civil, depois pelo Ministério Público. Eu dei entrada, mas tudo foi demorando tanto… e eu sempre buscando uma resposta que nunca vinha. Eu vi ser instaurada a CPI das Bets e acabar naquela farra. Me gerou muita frustração, muita tristeza. Eu tive a impressão de estar abandonada”, pontuou Vânia sobre testemunhar a proibição, com a qual vinha sonhando há meses. “Eu me senti ouvida”, resumiu.


A história de Vânia e Rafael foi apresentada originalmente pela

Agência Pública

, que identificou uma carta que ela enviou ao Senado durante a CPI das Bets, em que narra a tragédia familiar. Os impactos da

reportagem

 noticiados até fora …
